items.text: Career awareness activities for secondary school students should widen what they know about work without forcing early decisions, so use short, hands-on, age-appropriate activities such as guest talks, role plays, work visits and reflection sheets, and keep claims modest.
Run a few repeatable activities each term, include parents and local workers, and let students explore rather than choose.
Follow school safeguarding and consent rules for visits and guests.
